cluster_label: central main body follicle cell ca. St. 6-8
working_definition: Ovary follicle cells of the central main body region (overlying the oocyte/nurse cells) at roughly egg chamber stages 6-8 in adult female ovaries (Li et al. 2022, Fly Cell Atlas). Authors gave 'Manual Annotation' (no FBbt id).
searches_performed: central main body follicle cell ca. St. 6-8

best_match.fbbt_definition: Follicle cell that overlies the oocyte (Wu et al., 2008). Along with the posterior terminal follicle cells they form a columnar epithelium from stage 10, which deposits eggshell components (Wu et al., 2008). These cells are connected to one another by ring canals (Airoldi et al., 2011).

justification: The label names main body follicle cells restricted to a central subregion and approximate stage window; FBbt has no 'central main body follicle cell' or stage-specific main body term, so the cell type main body follicle cell is the most specific adequate ancestor.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: One of the somatic epithelial cells that is either associated with the germline cyst to form an egg chamber or connecting the egg chambers (Jevitt et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Less specific parent; main body follicle cell is available.

recommendation: Map to main body follicle cell (FBbt:00005402), broad match.
